state.paragraph: On October 30, six of the potentially interested parties submitted indications of interest. From October 30 to November 2, 2014, representatives of J.P. Morgan spoke by telephone with all of the potentially interested parties, including those that did not submit an indication of interest, to hear the parties' respective rationales for the price levels suggested in their indications or rationales for not submitting an indication. Three bidders initially indicated price ranges that reached at least $80.00 per share, including the Buyer Group, which indicated a range of $81.00 to $83.00 per share, and another bidder, which suggested a range of $80.00 to $85.00 per share. As a result of its discussions with J.P. Morgan, another bidder (which we refer to as "Bidder 2"), which had initially indicated a price of $78.00, increased its indication to a range of $81.00 to $84.00 per share.

ledger_rows.Note: Contacts: 27 parties (3 strategic not counting Industry Participant; 24 financial) approached J.P. Morgan mid-August–end October; ~15 expressed interest by the 10/03 board update.
Round 1 opened by the first-week-of-October confidentiality wave; the 10/30 indication due date was set later.
All 15 received October due diligence, management presentations and detailed financial and business-plan information.
Set non-binding preliminary indication due date of 10/30; communicated to the potential bidders during October.
Six of the potentially interested parties submitted indications of interest.
Preliminary non-binding indication; range $81.00–$83.00; consideration not stated.
Another of the six submitters; non-binding range $80.00–$85.00; not individually named.
Remainder of the six submitters; no individual detail or prices; one later advanced, two eliminated 11/03 (#24).
Raised after J.P. Morgan's 10/30–11/02 calls; range $81.00–$84.00; made it one of four at or above $80.00.
Final round opened by the 11/03 advancement of four bidders at or above $80.00; merger-agreement form circulated in November; updated FY2014 projections given to all finalists.
6 submitters − 4 advanced = 2 notified as eliminated; none could remain above their initial indications.
Set evening 12/10 for final bids, replacing the initial 12/05 plan; mark-ups and financing commitments requested in advance.

bid.instructions: `paragraph` reports that a bidder submits, revises, confirms or reaffirms a priced proposal, indication of interest or offer for the company. Is every such event in `paragraph` recorded by some entry in `ledger_rows` (same party, same kind of event, consistent date)?

criteria.true: Each such event has a matching ledger entry, possibly summarised in an entry's Note.
criteria.false: At least one such event in the paragraph has no matching ledger entry.
